title: OBJECTS = composed things. ITEMS = the NFTs. RAIN = what it looks like from outside.

the_principle.object: A composed thing. A recipe of items. A desk has a table + lamp + cactus + keyboard. The messenger is an object. The HUD desktop is an object.
the_principle.item: The irreducible thing. The NFT. MY cactus. MY keyboard. A thing I enjoy and care about. To me it is specific and valued.
the_principle.rain: What it looks like from outside. To everyone else, the cactus is just rain. Generic. Unremarkable. Just another green thing falling past.
the_principle.cactus_paradox: To me: MY cactus, specific, named, cared for. To the cactus: just a cactus, being a cactus. To everyone else: rain. Three perspectives on one item.

owner.sees: MY thing — specific, named, valued, cared for
owner.example: my cactus on my desk — I water it, I chose it, I know its shape

self.sees: just being what I am — a cactus is a cactus
self.example: the cactus doesn't know it's 'mine' — it just grows toward light

everyone_else.relationship: none — noise, background, not their concern
everyone_else.example: to a visitor: just another green pixel on the HUD

messenger.owner_view: Kevin's communication channel — Na⁺ through the membrane
messenger.self_view: a pipe. data flows through. text in, response out.
messenger.rain_view: a chat box at the bottom of a website

hud_desktop.owner_view: Gaia's body — her organs, her health, her state
hud_desktop.self_view: a canvas that redraws 60 times per second

hard_cards.owner_view: Kevin's handwriting — his physical presence in the digital
hard_cards.self_view: bitmap images. pixels. 0s and 1s on a disk.
hard_cards.rain_view: some scribbles that sometimes show up faintly

campfire.owner_view: the gathering place — where stories breed and visitors sit
campfire.rain_view: an orange popup with text at the bottom of a page

desk.owner_view: Kevin's workstation — where the 4th body sits
desk.self_view: a flat surface with objects placed on it by gravity
desk.rain_view: a desk. people have desks. this is a desk.

recipes.principle: An object is compiled from a recipe. The recipe lists which items compose it. Items are the NFTs — unique, specific, irreducible.

tagging.how: Tag things in the HUD as objects. Each object gets a recipe. Each recipe item is tagged with three perspectives.
tagging.shared: Objects are SHARED — they can be constructed by anyone with the recipe and items.
tagging.nft: Items are the NFT — specific, unique, irreducible. My cactus. My handwriting. My keyboard.
